265	    @classmethod
266	    def _from_checkpoint(cls, data: object) -> FleetSimulator:
267	        if not isinstance(data, dict):
268	            raise ValueError("checkpoint root must be a JSON object")
269	
270	        version = data.get("version")
271	        if not _is_int(version):
272	            raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'version' must be an integer")
273	        if version not in _SUPPORTED_VERSIONS:
274	            raise ValueError(
275	                f"unsupported checkpoint version {version}; supported versions: "
276	                f"{sorted(_SUPPORTED_VERSIONS)}"
277	            )
278	
279	        grid = cls._load_grid(data)
280	        tick = cls._load_tick(data)
281	        robot_records, task_records = cls._load_entities(data)
282	        replay = cls._load_replay(data)
283	
284	        robots: list[Robot] = []
285	        for record in robot_records:
286	            position = _as_pair(record["position"], f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} position")
287	            if not grid.traversable(position):
288	                raise ValueError(
289	                    f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} position {list(position)} is outside "
290	                    "the map or inside an obstacle"
291	                )
292	            route: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
293	            previous = position
294	            for index, cell in enumerate(record["route"]):
295	                waypoint = _as_pair(
296	                    cell, f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} route entry {index}"
297	                )
298	                if not grid.traversable(waypoint):
299	                    raise ValueError(
300	                        f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} route entry {list(waypoint)} is "
301	                        "outside the map or inside an obstacle"
302	                    )
303	                if abs(waypoint[0] - previous[0]) + abs(waypoint[1] - previous[1]) != 1:
304	                    raise ValueError(
305	                        f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} route moves non-adjacently from "
306	                        f"{list(previous)} to {list(waypoint)}"
307	                    )
308	                route.append(waypoint)
309	                previous = waypoint
310	            distance = record["distance_travelled"]
311	            if not _is_int(distance) or distance < 0:
312	                raise ValueError(
313	                    f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} distance_travelled must be a "
314	                    "non-negative integer"
315	                )
316	            robots.append(Robot(record["robot_id"], position, route, record["task_id"], distance))
317	
318	        tasks: list[Task] = []
319	        for record in task_records:
320	            pickup = _as_pair(record["pickup"], f"task {record['task_id']!r} pickup")
321	            dropoff = _as_pair(record["dropoff"], f"task {record['task_id']!r} dropoff")
322	            tasks.append(
323	                Task(
324	                    record["task_id"],
325	                    pickup,
326	                    dropoff,
327	                    record["assigned_robot"],
328	                    record["picked_up"],
329	                    record["completed"],
330	                )
331	            )
332	
333	        robot_by_id = {robot.robot_id: robot for robot in robots}
334	        task_by_id = {task.task_id: task for task in tasks}
335	
336	        for robot in robots:
337	            if robot.task_id is not None:
338	                task = task_by_id.get(robot.task_id)
339	                if task is None:
340	                    raise ValueError(
341	                        f"robot {robot.robot_id!r} executes unknown task {robot.task_id!r}"
342	                    )
343	                if task.completed:
344	                    raise ValueError(
345	                        f"robot {robot.robot_id!r} executes task {task.task_id!r} that is "
346	                        "already completed"
347	                    )
348	                if task.assigned_robot != robot.robot_id:
349	                    raise ValueError(
350	                        f"robot {robot.robot_id!r} executes task {task.task_id!r} but the "
351	                        f"task is assigned to {task.assigned_robot!r}"
352	                    )
353	        for task in tasks:
354	            if task.completed and not task.picked_up:
355	                raise ValueError(f"task {task.task_id!r} is completed but never picked up")
356	            if task.picked_up and task.assigned_robot is None:
357	                raise ValueError(
358	                    f"task {task.task_id!r} is picked up but has no assigned robot"
359	                )
360	            # Completed tasks retain historical ownership; their robots are free
361	            # to take new work, so the mutual binding only holds while a task is
362	            # still in progress.
363	            if not task.completed and task.assigned_robot is not None:
364	                owner = robot_by_id.get(task.assigned_robot)
365	                if owner is None:
366	                    raise ValueError(
367	                        f"task {task.task_id!r} is assigned to unknown robot "
368	                        f"{task.assigned_robot!r}"
369	                    )
370	                if owner.task_id != task.task_id:
371	                    raise ValueError(
372	                        f"task {task.task_id!r} claims robot {owner.robot_id!r} but the "
373	                        f"robot executes {owner.task_id!r}"
374	                    )
375	
376	        simulator = cls(grid, robots, tasks)
377	        simulator.tick = tick
378	        simulator.replay = copy.deepcopy(replay)
379	        cls._validate_replay_positions(replay, tick, robot_by_id)
380	        return simulator

432	        robot_ids: set[str] = set()
433	        for index, record in enumerate(raw_robots):
434	            if not isinstance(record, dict):
435	                raise ValueError(f"robot entry {index} must be an object")
436	            robot_id = record.get("robot_id")
437	            if not isinstance(robot_id, str):
438	                raise ValueError(f"robot entry {index} field 'robot_id' must be a string")

import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from warehouse_fleet import FleetSimulator, GridMap, Robot, Task, shortest_path


def demo_scenario() -> FleetSimulator:
    return FleetSimulator(
        GridMap(8, 6, frozenset({(3, 1), (3, 2), (3, 3), (5, 4)})),
        [Robot("R-01", (0, 0)), Robot("R-02", (7, 5))],
        [Task("T-100", (1, 4), (6, 0)), Task("T-200", (6, 5), (0, 2))],
    )


def run_until_done(simulator: FleetSimulator, limit: int = 30) -> FleetSimulator:
    for _ in range(limit):
        metrics = simulator.metrics()
        if metrics["tasks_completed"] == metrics["tasks_total"]:
            break
        simulator.step()
        metrics = simulator.metrics()
        if metrics["tasks_completed"] == metrics["tasks_total"]:
            break
    return simulator


class PathfindingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_shortest_path_avoids_obstacle(self) -> None:
        grid = GridMap(3, 3, frozenset({(1, 0)}))
        path = shortest_path(grid, (0, 0), (2, 0))
        self.assertEqual(path[-1], (2, 0))
        self.assertNotIn((1, 0), path)
        self.assertEqual(len(path), 4)


class SimulatorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_task_completes_and_metrics_are_recorded(self) -> None:
        simulator = FleetSimulator(
            GridMap(4, 2),
            [Robot("R-01", (0, 0))],
            [Task("T-01", (1, 0), (3, 0))],
        )
        for _ in range(3):
            simulator.step()
        self.assertTrue(simulator.tasks["T-01"].completed)
        self.assertEqual(simulator.metrics()["tasks_completed"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(simulator.metrics()["distance_total"], 3)


class CheckpointRoundTripTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _write_and_load(self, simulator: FleetSimulator) -> FleetSimulator:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path = os.path.join(tmp, "state.json")
            simulator.save_checkpoint(path)
            return FleetSimulator.load_checkpoint(path)

    def test_save_does_not_advance_or_mutate_instance(self) -> None:
        simulator = run_until_done(demo_scenario(), 6)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path = os.path.join(tmp, "state.json")
            before = simulator.snapshot()
            simulator.save_checkpoint(path)
            after = simulator.snapshot()
            self.assertEqual(before, after)
            self.assertEqual(simulator.tick, before["tick"])

    def test_zero_tick_empty_fleet_empty_tasks(self) -> None:
        simulator = FleetSimulator(GridMap(3, 3), [], [])
        loaded = self._write_and_load(simulator)
        self.assertEqual(loaded.tick, 0)
        self.assertEqual(loaded.replay, [])
        self.assertEqual(loaded.robots, {})
        self.assertEqual(loaded.tasks, {})
        self.assertEqual(loaded.metrics()["completion_ratio"], 1.0)

    def test_zero_tick_with_robots_round_trips(self) -> None:
        simulator = FleetSimulator(
            GridMap(4, 4), [Robot("A", (0, 0))], [Task("T", (1, 0), (3, 0))]
        )
        loaded = self._write_and_load(simulator)
        self.assertEqual(loaded.tick, 0)
        self.assertEqual(loaded.replay, [])
        run_until_done(loaded)
        self.assertTrue(loaded.tasks["T"].completed)

    def test_picked_up_but_not_delivered_resumes(self) -> None:

        mutate(document)
        return document

```python
def modify_map(self, add_obstacles=(), remove_obstacles=()) -> None:
    """Add/remove obstacle cells between ticks. Raises ValueError on invalid batch."""
    added = self._coerce_cells(add_obstacles, "add_obstacles")
    removed = self._coerce_cells(remove_obstacles, "remove_obstacles")
    # dedup
    added_set = set(added)
    removed_set = set(removed)
    # conflict
    if added_set & removed_set:
        raise ValueError(...)
    # bounds
    for cell in added_set | removed_set:
        if not self.grid.contains(cell):
            raise ValueError(...)
    # no-op filtering
    actual_added = added_set - self.grid.obstacles
    actual_removed = removed_set & self.grid.obstacles
    # robot coverage
    robot_positions = {r.position for r in self.robots.values()}
    if actual_added & robot_positions:
        raise ValueError(...)
    if not actual_added and not actual_removed:
        return  # no change, no record
    # apply
    new_obstacles = (self.grid.obstacles - actual_removed) | actual_added
    self.grid = GridMap(self.grid.width, self.grid.height, frozenset(new_obstacles))

@classmethod
def _load_map_history(cls, data, initial_grid, current_grid):
    raw = data.get("map_history")
    if raw is None:
        return []
    if not isinstance(raw, list):
        raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'map_history' must be a list")
    history = []
    obstacles = set(initial_grid.obstacles)
    for index, record in enumerate(raw):
        if not isinstance(record, dict):
            raise ValueError(f"map change {index} must be an object")
        tick = record.get("tick")
        if not _is_int(tick) or tick < 0:
            raise ValueError(f"map change {index} tick must be a non-negative integer")
        added = cls._load_cell_list(record.get("added"), f"map change {index} added")
        removed = cls._load_cell_list(record.get("removed"), f"map change {index} removed")
        added_set = set(added)
        removed_set = set(removed)
        if added_set & removed_set:
            raise ValueError(f"map change {index} adds and removes the same cell")
        # bounds
        for cell in added_set | removed_set:
            if not current_grid.contains(cell):
                raise ValueError(f"map change {index} cell {list(cell)} is outside the map")
        # replay validity
        for cell in added_set:
            if cell in obstacles:
                raise ValueError(f"map change {index} adds cell {list(cell)} that is already an obstacle")
        for cell in removed_set:
            if cell not in obstacles:
                raise ValueError(f"map change {index} removes cell {list(cell)} that is not an obstacle")
        obstacles = (obstacles - removed_set) | added_set
        history.append(MapChange(tick, frozenset(added_set), frozenset(removed_set)))
    final_grid = GridMap(current_grid.width, current_grid.height, frozenset(obstacles))
    if final_grid != current_grid:
        raise ValueError("map history does not restore the saved map")
    return history
```

    def modify_map(
        self,
        add_obstacles: Iterable[tuple[int, int]] = (),
        remove_obstacles: Iterable[tuple[int, int]] = (),
    ) -> None:
        """Close and/or reopen cells between two ticks.

        The batch is validated as a whole before anything is applied: every
        coordinate must be a pair of integers (booleans are not integers),
        lie inside the map, and no cell may appear on both sides. Adding an
        obstacle on a cell a robot currently occupies also rejects the whole
        batch. On rejection the map, routes, tasks, statistics and history
        are all left untouched.

        Duplicate coordinates within a batch are processed once. Adding an
        already blocked cell or removing an already open one is a no-op; a
        batch with no net effect changes nothing and is not recorded.

        An effective change flips the map immediately without advancing the
        clock, moving robots or adding mileage. Assigned, unfinished tasks
        keep their robot: a robot that has picked up replans to the dropoff
        only; a robot still heading to pickup replans from its current
        position via the pickup, confirming pickup first when it is already
        there. If any required segment or endpoint is unreachable the
        robot's remaining route is cleared and the task is paused (never
        released or marked complete) until a later change restores a path.
        """
        added = self._coerce_cells(add_obstacles, "add_obstacles")
        removed = self._coerce_cells(remove_obstacles, "remove_obstacles")
        added_set = frozenset(added)
        removed_set = frozenset(removed)
        if added_set & removed_set:
            raise ValueError(
                "cells "
                f"{sorted(added_set & removed_set)} are both added and removed"

        for cell in added_set | removed_set:
            if not self.grid.contains(cell):
                raise ValueError(f"cell {list(cell)} lies outside the map")
        actual_added = added_set - self.grid.obstacles
        actual_removed = removed_set & self.grid.obstacles
        robot_positions = frozenset(robot.position for robot in self.robots.values())
        if actual_added & robot_positions:
            raise ValueError(
                "cannot add obstacles at "
                f"{sorted(actual_added & robot_positions)}: a robot occupies the cell"

        if not actual_added and not actual_removed:
            return
        new_obstacles = (self.grid.obstacles - actual_removed) | actual_added
        self.grid = GridMap(self.grid.width, self.grid.height, frozenset(new_obstacles))
